neighbours.label: acting together as a single unit ('as a team', 'act like one', 'in a statement' from a group)
fire: After the loss, the coach told us to start playing as a team again.
The tribe can no longer act like one now that the brothers are divided.
The foreign ministers said in a joint statement that the fighting must stop.
If we stand together as one, they cannot break our union.
The orchestra has to breathe as one body during the slow movement.
Neighbours worked as a single group to rebuild the flooded school.
The squad moved as one unit across the open field.
The council voted as a bloc to reject the proposal.
quiet: After the loss, the coach told us to start running faster again.
The tribe can no longer hunt in the valley now that the river has dried.
The foreign minister said on the radio that the fighting must stop.
If we raise the price again, they cannot afford our product.
The orchestra has to tune its strings before the slow movement.
Neighbours donated money and paint to rebuild the flooded school.
The squad moved slowly across the open field.
The council voted late at night to reject the proposal.
